# Her Trees Puzzle Game (https://treespuzzle.com)

> Independent editorial guide and browser-playable hub for Stone's HER TREES non-verbal black-and-white puzzle series (First Puzzle, The Puzzle House, and Puzzle Dream) across 7 languages (`en`, `zh-cn`, `ja`, `fr`, `id`, `vi`, `fa`).

## Core Playable & Guide Pages

- [HER TREES Series Home (EN)](https://treespuzzle.com/)
- [HER TREES : First Puzzle — Play in Browser](https://treespuzzle.com/play/first-puzzle/)
- [HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE — Play & Overview](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-house/)
- [HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM — Play & Demo](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-dream/)
- [First Puzzle Walkthrough (A Forgotten House)](https://treespuzzle.com/guide/)
- [The Puzzle House Walkthrough & Hints](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-house/guide/)
- [Puzzle Dream Walkthrough & Answers](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-dream/guide/)
- [Puzzle Design Analysis](https://treespuzzle.com/analysis/puzzle-design/)
- [Puzzle Dream Android / iOS / Switch Platform Notes](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-dream/android/) · [iOS](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-dream/ios/) · [Switch](https://treespuzzle.com/play/puzzle-dream/switch/)
